title: Phytomanagement strategy leads to plant-derived catalysts for the sustainable synthesis of oxidized Hantzsch esters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00028A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anca-Elena Dascălu, Christophe Waterlot, Jenna Caudle, David Bulteel, Guillaume Dhainaut, Adeline Janus, Tristan Debuigne, Jean-Yves Cornu, Alina Ghinet
Through a phytomanagement strategy, metal-accumulating plants from contaminated soils were used to produce eco-catalysts, enabling the green oxidation of Hantzsch esters and other species for potential therapeutic applications.
